extraction_limitations: This is a model extraction from the v1 arXiv preprint and has not been independently human-verified; every atom is marked needs_review.
No funding, conflict-of-interest, or data-availability statement was extracted because none was identified in the inspected 16-page source text.
Reference-list statements were not atomized; cited prior work remains secondary context rather than evidence generated by this study.

Some appendix analyses report multiple related numerical values in prose/figures; atoms prioritize independently reviewable load-bearing assertions rather than exhaustively encoding every plotted point.
